messages:
Alex: Heads up — vendor emailed about reserved slot TTL for the apac-h100 pool; invoice for 6 racks is still pending. Anyone from vendor ops or procurement able to confirm if we need to submit a PO now or can extend the hold? @Carla @Liam
Carla: I saw that thread. Vendor said they'll hold the slots until EOD Friday if a PO is in flight. They specifically asked for a contract reference/LOA. I just pinged procurement and flagged it as expedited.
Liam: Terraform PR #458 is what wires the quota assignment for the new pool. I can add a purchase_ref var, but need the invoice/PO id to put in the branch. If procurement can drop the ref here I’ll update and request review.
vendor-bot: [vendor status] Holding 6 slots for customer 'redwood' until 2024-07-12T23:59Z. Invoice status: pending. Contact: ops@cloudvendor.example (auto-update: +6h)
Marie: If payment/PO doesn't land in time, fallback plan is to shift demo & internal test traffic to eu-west1 burst (lower perf but available). I can prepare the routing change and a short roll-back runbook — want me to start that?
Alex: Yes please, Marie — start the runbook. @Carla can you confirm procurement ETA? Also @ravi-finance we might need to expedite a partial pay to secure the hold.
Carla: Procurement estimates ~48 hours with expedited routing. One thing: vendor requires 50% upfront per the SOW for reserved racks. They said LOA + partial payment will secure the hold.
ravi-finance: We can push a 50% hold payment but need the vendor banking details and invoice id to create the payment. @Carla drop the invoice id and bank info and I'll trigger the payment flow.
Carla: Invoice ID: INV-2026-3315. Vendor details pasted below:
```
bank: ExampleBank
iban: GB29NWBK60161331926819
amount_due_partial: 150000
due_by: 2024-07-11
```
Liam: Added `purchase_ref = "INV-2026-3315"` to the terraform branch and left a comment on PR #458. Holding merge until procurement confirms. CC @Alex for rollout window.
Alex: Thanks — also can we add a routing policy: if apac pool available_gpus < 4, route demo->eu-burst automatically? Marie, can you add an alert and a small policy in Console for that threshold?
Marie: Yep. Creating alert + policy now and I'll attach the runbook snippet. Will also add the manual fallback steps in the runbook in case the auto-route has issues.
Carla: Vendor Ops just replied — they can extend hold to 2024-07-15 if we sign an LOA today. Otherwise EOD Friday.
Alex: OK — priority is LOA sign today. @Carla please drop the LOA doc in this thread when ready and @ravi-finance proceed with the partial payment flow once you have bank details. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
